description: Forward Claude Code hook events to the local coflux daemon through the cofluxd messenger (silent no-op when cofluxd is not installed); at session start, inside a coflux terminal, print the <coflux-session> block with the session's coflux coordinates; on every prompt, print a <coflux-session-moved> block when the working directory sits in a different coflux workspace than the terminal does; follow the agent into git worktrees (EnterWorktree, ExitWorktree, resume and Claude Code's own cleanup move the terminal's owning workspace, registering an unknown worktree first); inside a coflux project session, steer `git worktree remove|move` to the coflux account CLI workspace commands.

hooks.command: sh -c 'command -v cofluxd >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec cofluxd hook claude || :'
